324:t_011:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Whew... It looks like we can finally catch our breath.」

324:t_011:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「By the way, who is piloting that pink AT?」

324:t_011:9.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I am $$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$. Though I have abandoned the $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ name.」

324:t_011:10.en:
$$スザク$$
「She's a $$マーティアル$$ $$ネクスタント$$...!」

324:t_011:11.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Are you sure about this, $$キリコ$$?」

324:t_011:15.en:
$n
「She's the one who kidnapped $$フィアナ$$. She must be plotting some-」

324:t_011:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「If $$キリコ$$ says it's fine, then it's fine!」

324:t_011:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's none of our business! If you've got time for that, hurry up and finish off the enemy!」

324:t_011:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Since $$マーティアル$$ has made us a target, we will meet their attack.」

324:t_011:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We will wipe out both the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$ and $$マーティアル$$ in one stroke!」

324:t_012:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「I have confirmed the destruction of both the bandits and $$マーティアル$$.」

324:t_012:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That woman, $$テイタニア$$, seems to be on the run from $$マーティアル$$.」

324:t_012:2.en:
$n
「So she teamed up with $$キリコ$$ because they're after him too.」

324:t_012:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「I thought you'd grown up a little, but you still haven't got a clue about women's feelings, $n.」

324:t_012:6.en:
$n
「Women's feelings... Are you really one to talk?」

324:t_012:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's exactly the sort of thing I'm talking about!」

324:t_012:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I agree with $$カレン$$ this time. You have work to do, $n.」

324:t_012:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That completes our job. We should have enough money to keep operating for now.」

324:t_012:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You were hunting bandits for money, huh... It sounds like you've had it pretty rough.」

324:t_012:13.en:
$$カトル$$
「I'm sorry, $$ゼロ$$. If I'd joined you a little sooner, I could probably have helped...」

324:t_012:15.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「$$カトル$$'s family is rich, after all.」

324:t_012:16.en:
$$ノイン$$
「We regrouped with aid from $$カトル$$'s family and support from the $$マグアナック隊$$.」

324:t_012:18.en:
$n
「It's all right, $$ゼロ$$. We helped a town in trouble.」

324:t_012:19.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let us take this as an ironic lesson for demanding payment for justice.」

324:t_012:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, return! We will collect our payment in $$グルフェー$$ and consider our next move!」

324:t_012:23.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Am I... allowed to stay...?」

324:t_013:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even as the Empire takes over the world, some refuse to abandon their greed, and others cling stubbornly to their faith...」

324:t_013:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I suppose that, too, is human nature...」

324:t_013:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We don't have time to get sentimental. This time, we have to take advantage of the bad guys fighting each other.」

324:t_014:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
(There are still enemies... The fighting still isn't over...)

324:t_014:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Will this cycle go on forever...?)

324:t_100:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(I can sense them lurking around me... What do they want...?)

324:t_101:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(Even without my auxiliary brain and my powers as a $$ネクスタント$$, I can still fight.)

324:t_101:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$キリコ$$... I cannot let you die.)

324:t_102:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(The feelings $$フィアナ$$ entrusted to me... And my own feelings...)

324:t_102:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$キリコ$$... You are my reason to live...)

324:t_103:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「The bandits and $$マーティアル$$ are both our enemies...! Let's go, $$ヒイロ$$!」

324:t_103:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You seem to have put your doubts behind you, $$五飛$$.」

324:t_103:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「I have no doubts now! I dedicate my life to battle... and to the peace beyond it!」

324:t_104:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...Are you sure, $$ヒルデ$$? You could have gone with the $$マグアナック隊$$.」

324:t_104:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I already told you how I feel, $$デュオ$$.」

324:t_104:2.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I know hard battles lie ahead. But I'm part of $c too, so I'll fight alongside you all, $$デュオ$$.」

324:t_104:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Okay. I won't question your resolve ever again.」

324:t_104:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Let's go, $$ヒルデ$$! Follow me!」

324:t_105:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「Our fight begins again here, doesn't it?」

324:t_105:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「This is a fresh start. Our fight will not end until peace returns to this planet.」

324:t_105:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「Let's go, $$トロワ$$, and show them our resolve.」

324:t_106:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'm sure the members of $c who aren't here are fighting their own battles too.」

324:t_106:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Yes. Let's join them and begin our counterattack, $$ゼクス$$.」

324:t_106:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「No... Our counterattack begins this very moment.」

324:t_106:3.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I understand, $$ゼクス$$. I will follow you.」

324:t_106:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Let's go, $$ノイン$$! Our fight is not over yet!」

324:t_107:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-At last, a real battle... Will I be able to serve as captain...?!」

324:t_107:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I have to do it! I, too, am a member of $c!」

324:t_107:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's get fired up... Battle, battle!」
